note: Edit the questions here. Shown on /faq and used for Google’s FAQ structured data.

items.q: How do I place an order?
items.a: Add pieces to your order list, open the order page and press “Send order on WhatsApp”. We pre-fill a message with every item, size, quantity and an order reference. The studio confirms availability and shipping, and you pay once everything is confirmed.

items.q: Do I need an account?
items.a: No. Your order list, saved items and details are stored on your own device. Nothing is charged on this website.

items.q: Can I order without WhatsApp?
items.a: Yes — use the “Copy message” button on the order page and send it by email or Instagram, or order through an agent using the agent button on each product.

items.q: Can I change my order after sending it?
items.a: As long as it has not been paid and packed, simply reply in the same WhatsApp chat with the change.

items.q: Do you offer pre-orders?
items.a: Some styles are produced in numbered runs and sold as pre-order. The product page shows the expected shipping date, and pre-order items ship together with the rest of your order unless you ask us to split it.

items.q: What is a buying agent?
items.a: An agent buys products from Chinese marketplaces like Weidian on your behalf, stores them in a warehouse, sends you quality-control photos and ships everything to you in one parcel.

items.q: Which agents can I use?
items.a: Every product page lists the agents we work with. If your favourite agent is not listed, copy the product link — most agents accept Weidian links directly.

items.q: Are prices the same through an agent?
items.a: The item price is the same as in our Weidian store. Your agent may add their own service and shipping fees.

items.q: In which currency do I pay?
items.a: Our store currency is Chinese yuan (CNY). Prices in EUR, USD or GBP are converted at a recent exchange rate and are indicative. The exact total is confirmed before you pay.

items.q: Which payment methods do you accept?
items.a: We agree on a secure payment method in the WhatsApp chat once your order is confirmed. When ordering through an agent, you pay the agent using their methods.

items.q: When do I pay?
items.a: Only after the studio has confirmed availability, shipping and the total amount.

items.q: Do you ship worldwide?
items.a: Yes. See the shipping table on the How to order page for indicative delivery times per region.

items.q: How much does shipping cost?
items.a: Shipping depends on weight, destination and the line you choose. The order page shows an estimated parcel weight; we quote the exact price in the chat.

items.q: Will I get a tracking number?
items.a: Always. Tracking is shared in the same WhatsApp conversation as soon as your parcel leaves.

items.q: Do I have to pay import duties?
items.a: Depending on your country, customs duties or VAT may apply on arrival. These are set by your local customs authority and are not included in our prices.

items.q: How do Cola Studio pieces fit?
items.a: Most tops are cut boxy and oversized with dropped shoulders. Every product page lists the intended fit and exact garment measurements.

items.q: How do I find my size?
items.a: Measure a garment you love lying flat and compare it to our size chart, or use the fit finder on the size guide page.

items.q: Are the measurements garment or body measurements?
items.a: Garment measurements, laid flat. “½” means measured across the front — double it for the full circumference.

items.q: Can I exchange a size?
items.a: Contact us within 7 days of delivery with your order reference. Exchanges depend on stock and the item must be unworn with labels attached. Return shipping is at the customer's expense.

items.q: What if my item arrives damaged?
items.a: Send photos in your WhatsApp chat within 48 hours of delivery and we will make it right.

items.q: I ordered through an agent — who handles returns?
items.a: Agents usually handle returns while the item is still in their warehouse. Check the QC photos carefully before shipping.

items.q: How accurate is the live stock?
items.a: Stock is synchronised automatically with our Weidian store. Numbers can change between sending your order and our confirmation, which is why we always confirm first.

items.q: Will a sold-out item come back?
items.a: Core styles are restocked regularly. Use “Notify me” on the product page and we will message you when your size is back.

items.q: Where do I hear about new drops?
items.a: On the Studio updates page — posts from our Weibo are translated automatically — and through drop alerts on WhatsApp.

items.q: How should I wash heavyweight cotton?
items.a: Cold, inside out, and lay flat to dry. Our terry is pre-shrunk, but tumble drying can still affect the shape.

items.q: How do I care for knitwear?
items.a: Hand wash cold with a wool detergent and dry flat in shape. Store folded, never on a hanger.

items.q: How do I care for waxed canvas?
items.a: Spot clean only and re-wax seasonally. The wax develops character with wear.
